newsitem.title: USA: FINOVA unit files for 2.0 mln preferred.
newsitem.headline: FINOVA unit files for 2.0 mln preferred.

text.p: FINOVA Finance Trust, a unit of FINOVA Group Inc, filed on Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of up to 2.0 million convertible preferred securities worth $100 million.

The trust will use net proceeds to buy convertible subordinated debentures due 2016 of FINOVA Group. The parent will contribute the proceeds to its FINOVA Capital unit, which will use the funds to repay commercial paper and other debt.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Montgomery Securities and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
The underwriters have an over-allotment option on up to 300,000 additonal preferred shares.
FINOVA is a Phoenix, Ariz.,-based financing and leasing company.
